_comment: Per-UiMap travel geometry for the SimC DungeonRoute delay estimate, derived from Blizzard DBC and keyed by MDT mapId (MDT.mapInfo[idx].mapID). Per-axis world-yard scale: yardsPerUnitX = extentX / 840, yardsPerUnitY = extentY / 560, where the dungeon floor fills MDT's 840x560 base canvas and the UiMapAssignment world bounds give extentX/extentY. For a 1.5:1 floor the two axes are equal (the values below, migrated from the former single yardsPerUnit); non-1.5 floors keep distinct X/Y. 560 (Maisara Caverns) and 559 (Nexus Point Xenas) are calibrated from their floor UiMaps (2501, whose parent 2437 is the Zul'Aman zone; and 2556) — their MDT mapIDs resolve to parent/zone UiMaps, which is why these two were blank before. timerSeconds = MapChallengeMode.CriteriaCount_0 (the +1 par timer). Regenerate from DBC when the season/dungeon set changes.
